purpose: Single source of truth for Planner catalogue + deterministic allowlist + chat roles. RAG routing_card prose is policy text, not route numbers.

value_factors.improves: Stops catalogue/allowlist drift; unknown specialist_id fails closed before Call Workflow
value_factors.not: Extra bureaucracy fields that the Planner never uses

value_factors.improves: Excel→Schedule handoff only when source_facts_packet has snapshot+correlation; UI can list facts
value_factors.not: Full OpenAPI for every compact_data key

value_factors.improves: Incomplete gaps cannot open Excel loop; chat can show exact missing field chips
value_factors.not: Free-form prose gaps that burn budget

value_factors.improves: Every cross-specialist edge becomes a reconstructable chat turn in mas_trace_events

capabilities: normalized source facts for downstream specialists

depends_on: approved normalized source facts when tabular evidence is needed
one or more uploaded .dev trajectories and exactly one ASCII CPS3 surface in the same CRS, units, vertical datum and Z sign convention

capabilities: submit calculation jobs on a remote cluster
return job_id / status / log refs without embedding raw SSH transcripts
depends_on: job_spec in specialist_packet.inputs and/or attached scripts; SSH or job-API credential configured in the adapter
constraints: never exposes SSH credentials or private keys in specialist_result
never calls Binary Results or Presentation specialists directly
async work uses continuation + retryable_error / needs_input

capabilities: extract typed fields needed for reports
assemble a compact report_facts packet for Presentation
depends_on: binary result artifacts from Cluster Calculation (or equivalent) attached to the execution or referenced in artifact_refs
constraints: never stores raw binaries in CAS JSON columns
never invents numeric values missing from the binary
never calls Cluster or Presentation specialists directly

capabilities: assemble presentation / visualization from report facts
produce slide index and chart specs as compact_data
depends_on: report_facts_packet (or equivalent) from Binary Results Extractor / prior specialist_result
constraints: does not re-run cluster jobs or re-parse binaries
does not approve release — Orchestrator / Human Gate decide
